δουλεία (T, -λία), -ας, ἡ
(δουλεύω), [in LXX, as Exo.13:3, for עֶבֶד and cognates ;]
slavery, bondage: Rom.8:15, 21 Gal.4:24 5:1, Heb.2:15.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”
These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.
and might deliver all of them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
